description: Bundled Claude Code / MCP skill for GA4GH Genomic Knowledge Standards (GKS) suite, shipped alongside the `@deepseek-ai/dsh-ga4gh-gks` Cordis plugin and standalone MCP server in the `ga4gh-plugins` monorepo. Meta-skill for the GA4GH Genomic Knowledge Standards (GKS) suite — mounts the bundled ga4gh-vrs plugin and lists which GKS-family standards this suite currently bundles. Use when the user asks about GA4GH GKS, wants variant/knowledge-representation tooling across the GKS family, or asks which GKS standards this package composes.
